front:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original 16-part skeletal game character atlas.
Primary request: Rebuild the Crown Shieldbearer in reference1 as premium original modern game artwork, separated into modular body parts for continuous animation. Reference1 determines his identity and clothes. Reference2 determines ONLY the 4x4 component layout and surface quality; do NOT copy its armor, helmet, face or cape.
Character: broad sturdy adult man in his late thirties with a warm light-tan weathered face, medium-length wavy chestnut hair, brown neatly full beard, NO helmet and NO topknot. Practical dark petrol-teal diamond-quilted padded tunic with restrained ochre-gold fabric edging over cream linen sleeves, teal hood resting down around shoulders, diagonal brown leather chest strap, dark belt with square brass buckle and small utility pouch. Split knee-length teal quilted hip panels, fitted charcoal trousers, scuffed tall brown leather boots, sturdy leather forearm bracers. Honest cloth-armored infantry silhouette, not plate armor. Right-hand axe and left round shield must remain separate: NO weapons or shield baked into this body sheet.
View: FRONT, elevated25degree orthographic camera. Same direction for all components. Realistic believable adult anatomy and rich fine wovencloth/leather materials, premium 3D rendered game surfaces, no outlines or pixelart. Soft warm upper-left key, cool ambient bounce.
Exactly16 isolated components in regular4columns by4rows. Complete pieces centered with transparent gutters; no assembled figure. Limb shafts straight DOWN, no bent elbows baked into artwork. Smooth rounded overlapping jointcaps.
Row1: head+neck with hair/beard but no hood; torso from shoulders to belt with quilted cloth and lowered hood at collar, NO head and NO arms; belt/pouch/split-quilt hip garment with NO legs; separate small brown leather utility pouch, unused alternate accessory, NO cape.
Row2: anatomicalLEFT upper sleeve shoulder-to-elbow; RIGHT upper sleeve shoulder-to-elbow; LEFT bracer forearm elbow-to-wrist without hand; RIGHT bracer forearm without hand.
Row3: LEFT softlyclosed gripping hand plus wrist; RIGHT softlyclosed gripping hand plus wrist; exactly ONE LEFT trouser thigh hip-to-knee; exactly ONE RIGHT trouser thigh. Each is a single segment, never shorts or two legs per cell.
Row4: LEFT trouser shin knee-to-ankle; RIGHT trouser shin; LEFT leather boot toes toward camera; RIGHT leather boot toes toward camera.
Hands naturally relaxed closed grips: fingers curled and thumb touches index, leaving a small genuinely empty opening for an invisible vertical tool handle. No tools in the hands.
CRITICAL torso: continuous complete teal quilted underlying garment across both shoulder attachment areas. No bare skin circle, no black hollow arm socket, no transparent shoulder hole. Detached sleeves will overlap the continuous torso in animation, so the torso must remain covered cloth when arms swing.
No weapons, shield, cargo, scenery, floor, drop shadows, labels, text, grid, checkerboard or backgroundcolor. Genuine transparent PNG RGBA blankspace alpha0.
partContractCorrection:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
This modular sheet has three rigging errors. Correct those only, preserving the character identity, materials and16-part4x4 grid.
1. Row2 column1 and column2 must be ONLY UPPER ARMS from shoulder to elbow. Replace each current long whole arm with a short isolated teal quilted short sleeve with gold edging over a small cream linen bicep section ending immediately at elbow. No forearm and NO leather bracer on these two upper-arm parts. The separate forearms in row2 columns3 and4 stay unchanged.
2. Row4 column1 and column2 must be ONLY trouser SHINS from knee to ankle. Remove their entire boots and feet. Each replacement is a straight vertical charcoal trouser lower-leg segment with a little wrapped fabric at ankle, cut at ankle, NO foot/toe/sole, NO boot. Leave standalone boots in row4 columns3 and4 unchanged.
3. Close the black hollow arm sockets on the row1 column2 torso with continuous matching teal quilted cloth. No hollow black opening or exposed bare skin circle. The detached sleeve is attached on top of this solid cloth surface in the animation.
Everything else stays in the same cells and scale: head, torso identity, hip skirt, pouch, forearms, gripping hands, thighs and separate boots. Realistic original game art. Real transparent alpha background, no checkerboard, no labels.

transparentExtraction:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: transparent PNG game sprite sheet
Primary request: Extract all separate character components from the supplied image onto a genuinely transparent background with an alpha channel.
Input image: edit target.
Constraints: keep every component and its placement, detail, color, facing direction and size unchanged. Remove only the painted checkerboard background. Preserve clean edges and all gaps. The output is a transparent cutout PNG, not an illustration of cutouts on paper.
